name: Gagne Foods
old_description: Gagne Foods is a family-run company proudly manufacturing fine frozen baked goods on the coast of Maine. Taste is the cornerstone of our brand.
about:
Gagne Foods operates from Bath, Maine, as a family-owned manufacturer of frozen baked goods. The company has not publicly disclosed its founding year or the names of its founders, but it emphasizes a family-run heritage and a commitment to taste as its cornerstone.

The product line centers on artisanal laminated dough, yielding items such as all-butter biscuits, hand pies, scones, galettes, pie bites, cinnamon rolls, and take-and-bake pastries. All items are sold frozen and ready to bake, with the company also offering contract manufacturing and custom program development for bakery and food-service clients.

Customers include food-service operators, retail bakeries, and brands seeking private-label frozen pastries. Gagne Foods works with regional and seasonal product requests, providing tailored formulations and merchandising support to drive sales for its partners.

The company differentiates itself through a clean-label philosophy — simple, real ingredients — and a focus on buttery, flaky dough made with all butter. It positions taste as the primary driver, aiming to build community around its products without compromising on flavor.
